subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: After preserving unrelated custom IDs, should `gpt-5.6` remain a moving browser alias while `gpt-5.6-sol` stays permanently pinned to Sol?
rationale: The detector repair is mechanical, but future retargeting of a public CLI model identifier is a durable compatibility policy that cannot be inferred safely from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve both contracts
options.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` movable and `gpt-5.6-sol` pinned after narrowing the detector.

options.title: Pin both aliases
options.body: Keep both accepted aliases permanently mapped to the Sol picker entry.

options.title: Expose only Sol
options.body: Remove the moving generic alias and support only the explicit pinned alias.

recommendation.title: Approve both contracts
recommendation.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` movable and `gpt-5.6-sol` pinned after narrowing the detector.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing model-routing contract and adjacent GPT-5.6 picker merge trace to his current-main history.
